verdict.rationale: SavvyCal publishes a structured REST API reference at developers.savvycal.com/api/savvycal-meetings-api that documents OAuth 2.0, Bearer and personal-access-token security schemes, so a browsable reference exists. Nothing shows it is interactive or has runnable examples, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
